recommendedFeatures.feature: User-initiated copy of one detected media URL
recommendedFeatures.basis: Cat Catch popup.js lines253-258 implements per-item URL copy; popup-utils.js lines1-11 derives link; Baseline My Video App1.13.0 popup/ui expose no clipboard action.
recommendedFeatures.benefit: Reuse discovered direct/HLS/DASH URL in a separately selected downloader or local player without starting a download; URL may expire or require original session.
recommendedFeatures.constraints: Own small implementation; validate HTTP(S) mediaURL; synchronous click triggers writeText before awaits; never clipboard.read or automatic copying; no new permissions/dependencies/backend; report unavailable or denied clipboard honestly; raw detected URL may include signed tokens so copy only on explicit action.
recommendedFeatures.risk: Session-bound URLs can expire; copying does not turn page URLs into extractor support or transfer login cookies.
recommendedFeatures.decision: Selected for1.14.0 independent implementation in popup and full app; click-only copy with manual fallback on browser denial or unavailable clipboard.

recommendedFeatures.feature: Local keyword/type filter for detected media
recommendedFeatures.basis: Cat Catch popup.html93-99 has resource filter controls; popup.js27-30/442-465 filters extension types.
recommendedFeatures.benefit: Navigate many detected media candidates without extra requests.
recommendedFeatures.constraints: Use simple bounded string search and existing file/hls/dash/audio metadata; no regex engine; no dependencies/network/storage needed; preserve refresh state and keyboard focus.
recommendedFeatures.risk: UI/search tests and empty-state distinctions required.
recommendedFeatures.decision: Deferred; retain as a small future candidate without enlarging this release scope.

deferredFeatures.basis: yt-dlp README682-688 documents continue and part files.
deferredFeatures.reason: Valuable for multi-GB downloads but requires durable partial-file ownership, validators, quotas, authenticated retry and recovery migration; not a safe tiny UI addition.

deferredFeatures.feature: Schedulers, download-rate control and new native manager
deferredFeatures.basis: AB README23-30 queues/schedulers/browser extensions; yt-dlp rate/retry options.
deferredFeatures.reason: Current app already bounded queue/retry/concurrency; scheduling requires new background lifecycle and rate controls need transfer-wide fairness; keep scope and bytes small.

deferredFeatures.feature: Language-specific track selection and MKV stream outputs
deferredFeatures.basis: HLS Downloader README38-42 quality/audio language/bitrate, disk-backed MP4/MKV.
deferredFeatures.reason: Current quality/disk merge already exist; additional track selection/output format expands parser/validation/UI scope rather than directly reducing build.
Would add backend/network/privacy/deployment dependency inconsistent with current offline local processing.

implementationPolicy.codeReuse: No competitor source copied; feature independently implemented using existing URL validation and browser clipboard API.
implementationPolicy.measurementScope: Build size is measured separately against baseline1.13.0; no competitor binary size or speed claims.
